title: Irish conditional flexibility study
summary: Same 20 MW load and line outage: the near-wind location admits 14.06 MW more hypothetical wind than the distant location in the checked prepared model.
scope: Public Irish planning network, hypothetical wind and flexible load, declared preparatory tap and shunt changes. Snapshot MW only.
independent_method: Separate RAW text parser and winding-side electrical equations; original numerical ratings and voltage/generator bounds retained.
claim_not_allowed: Measured avoided Irish curtailment, national percentages, profit, operating approval or demonstrated AI optimisation advantage.

findings.label: Original source status
findings.detail: The unmodified V33 file has 173 voltage violations; V35 has a different stored operating point. Neither is silently replaced or declared a passed source.

findings.label: Prepared numerical scenario
findings.detail: Source-bounded tap changes and one explicitly hypothetical capacitor disconnection produce a starting state passing the implemented static checks.

findings.label: Equal-demand location comparison
findings.detail: Bus 2072: 47.66 MW; bus 1341: 61.72 MW best tested wind acceptance. Both serve 7,344.51 MW consumer demand.

findings.label: Real asset access and operational scope
findings.detail: Site flexibility, actual ratings, tariffs, control permissions and security studies remain unverified.
